title: Subscription

denied.title: Subscription is for the salon owner only
denied.hint: Only the salon’s administrator can view and settle its platform subscription.

included.booking: Online booking around the clock, on a page in your name
included.reminders: Automatic confirmations and reminders by email and SMS
included.backOffice: Schedule, team, client records and counter checkout
included.reporting: Revenue, appointments and no-shows at a glance

welcome.title: Welcome! Your salon is open
welcome.body: Your {days}-day free trial has started. Next step: add your services, so they show up on your booking page.

confirming.title: Payment being confirmed
confirming.body: Stripe has not confirmed your card yet. This takes a few seconds.

canceled.title: Payment interrupted
canceled.body: No card was saved. You can pick this up whenever you like.

managed.title: Salon supported by the platform
managed.body: Your salon was opened by the platform team: there is no subscription for you to settle here.

pending.title: Your free trial has not started yet
pending.body: Save your card to open your salon: nothing is charged during the {days}-day trial, and you can cancel at any time. Until the trial starts, your booking page stays closed.

trialing.title: Free trial under way
trialing.body: Your salon is open. The first charge of {price} will be taken at the end of the trial, unless you cancel before then.

active.title: Subscription active
active.bodyUntil: Your salon is open. Next charge on {date}.

past_due.title: The last payment failed
past_due.body: Your salon stays open while the payment is retried. Update your card to avoid it closing.

canceled.title: Subscription cancelled
canceled.body: Your salon is closed: online booking and the back office are suspended. Your services, your team and your client records are kept — everything reopens as soon as you reactivate.

errors.notApplicable: This subscription cannot be changed from here right now. Refresh the page to see where it stands.
errors.accountMissing: No payment method has been saved yet. Start your free trial first.
errors.unavailable: Stripe is momentarily unavailable. Please try again in a few seconds.
errors.session: Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.

secure: Payment secured by Stripe: your card details never pass through our servers.
